What the shop offers

From the shop sign, the Instagram profile and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Cakes and pastries

Basque cheesecake, honey cake, tiramisu and carrot cake come up in the reviews. 9 Google reviews mention the pastries, 4 the homemade cakes.

Cakes for celebrations

Birthday, wedding and christening cakes are on the Instagram profile, wedding cakes and events on the shop sign. One guest orders cakes here for every celebration.

Coffee, tea and gelato

The shop sign says espresso bar and gelato. 2 reviews mention the pistachio ice cream, 2 the tea selection, and one guest the house-made lemonade.

Cookies, bites and savoury

The Instagram profile lists cookies and bites and savoury food. One guest took home four cake slices and a small loaf of rye bread.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from the Instagram profile and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Cosy

11 Google reviews mention the cosy atmosphere. One guest calls the interior beautiful.

House-made, less sugar

The Instagram profile says house-made, with less sugar. One guest calls everything very fresh and delicious.

Friendly owners

3 reviews mention the friendly owners. One guest got an oat cookie to try for free.

On Makarios Avenue

At Archbishop Makarios III Avenue 51, in the centre of Nicosia. Open every day, Monday to Friday from 8:30 to 19:00, Saturday and Sunday from 9:00 to 19:00.

What guests say

Three of 92 Google reviews, 89 of them with five stars.

“Hidden gem! Best deserts in Cyprus, incredibly delicious cheesecakes. Beautiful interior. A big tea collection.”

Google review
“Cozy little place in the heart of Nicosia center. Great quality coffee, amazing house made lemonade and so so great sweets! We loved it!”
